title: Messy Jobs: The Work That AI Cannot Reach — 15-card visual primer and notes
author_or_organization: Luis Garicano, Jin Li, and Yanhui Wu; visual primer and notes by Thomas Wolf (@Thom_Wolf)
source_type: visual book primer and organizational-economics synthesis
limitations: Curated 15-card visual primer and reading commentary posted by Thomas Wolf (co-founder and CSO of Hugging Face) summarizing the book Messy Jobs: The Work That AI Cannot Reach (Luis Garicano, Jin Li, and Yanhui Wu, Upriver Press, 2026; canonical book website https://messyjobs.ai/), rather than a direct full-text audit of the book. Several diagrams are explicitly schematic (task bundles, middle-market sag, Spence hiring signals, workslop hours, career pyramid, mediocrity curve, and Baumol two-sector GDP model). Cited secondary statistics vary in recency and sample scope (including Dhanoa et al. 2013 on 14 radiologists, Microsoft/LinkedIn Work Trend Index 2024, St. Louis Fed Nov 2025, SignalFire May 2025, an unsourced Ramp inference-spend mention on Card 2, and METR July 2025—which Card 14 explicitly notes METR's February 2026 update called out of date).
